About this Event

Sound Bath at the George Washington Masonic Memorial Hall with Beth Wolfe + Liat Pisco.
Join us for a deeply restorative Sound Bath inside the breathtaking Memorial Hall of the George Washington Masonic National Memorial — one of the most stunning and resonant spaces in the region.
The session features a powerful blend of crystal singing bowls, chimes, gong, rain stick, crystal pyramid, and other healing instruments, played to support deep relaxation, energetic clearing, and inner alignment.
This is more than a sound bath — it’s a one-of-a-kind vibrational journey in an awe-inspiring architectural gem. Whether you’re new to sound healing or returning to the practice, this evening offers a profound opportunity to reset and reconnect.
Space is limited. Please bring a yoga mat, blanket, eye mask, pillow or anything you need to be comfortable lying down.
